options.text: The image is upright, the same size as the pencil, appears behind the mirror, and cannot be obtained on a screen.
The image is upright, smaller than the pencil, appears behind the mirror, and cannot be obtained on a screen.
The image is upright, the same size as the pencil, appears behind the mirror, and can be obtained on a screen.
Every mirror forms an upright image of the same size as the object.

stem:
Aarav holds a pencil in front of a plane mirror on his desk and studies the image of the pencil.

Which set of properties is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: A plane mirror forms an upright, same-size virtual image behind the mirror that cannot be caught on a screen; size is not reduced, and the claim does not cover every kind of mirror.
